text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Unusually determined, Oguri Cap asks
to extend
today's training session.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I need to work as hard as everyone else
in the
academy put together... No, even
more than that!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
...Everyone here runs all the time. Even
at this
hour, they're all still running.
choice_data_list_en: Where did this come from all of a sudden?
What brought this on all of a sudden?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Unless I get on their level, I probably
won't make
it in the central races.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
What I'm doing now isn't gonna cut it. If
I wanna
win, I have no choice but to
train even harder.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As promised, Oguri Cap gets down to
business
and completes a lengthy
training session.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
...Am I focusing too hard on other
people's
progress?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... You're right. Okay, let's wind
things down
for today.

choice_data_list_en: Oguri has her own way of doing things.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Oguri Cap seems to have grasped my
point, at
least in her own way. I see her
periodically
nodding to herself as she
walks away.
